name: ARTRONIQ
recent: Artroniq 于11月完成收购 Hutchinson Asset Management Series B 75%股权的交易，后者成为全资子公司。公司自10月起持续在公开市场回购股份，并推进最多10%新股的非公开配售。最新季度营收环比与同比均大幅增长，并转亏为盈。
notable: 完成收购 Hutchinson Asset Management Series B 75%股权，代价 RM5.15 million，后者成为全资子公司。
142,000 股新股（占已发行股本10%），已获 Bursa Securities 批准上市。
近期持续进行股份回购（SBB）。
risks: 非公开配售最多10%新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
董事在闭门期前表示有意交易公司证券。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收 MYR 5.399 million，环比增长142.8%，同比增长69.7%；净利 MYR 34,000，净利率0.6%，较上季净利率 -49.0% 转正。

news.title: Artroniq expands F&B business with RM10m acquisition

events.what_en: Deadline for the quarter ending Sep (Bursa rule)

recent_en: Artroniq completed the acquisition of a 75% stake in Hutchinson Asset Management Series B in November, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The company has been buying back shares on the open market since October and is pursuing a private placement of up to 10% new shares. Latest quarterly revenue rose sharply QoQ and YoY, turning profitable.
notable_en: Completed acquisition of 75% equity interest in Hutchinson Asset Management Series B for RM5.15 million; it became a wholly-owned subsidiary.
Proposed private placement of up to 51,142,000 new shares (10% of issued shares), with listing approved by Bursa Securities.
risks_en: Private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Directors indicated intention to deal in company securities ahead of the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 5.399 million, up 142.8% QoQ and 69.7% YoY; net income was MYR 34,000 with a net margin of 0.6%, turning positive from -49.0% in the prior quarter.
